text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Concomitant use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) like naproxen with methotrexate may increase the risk for methotrexate toxicity, including adverse effects such as neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and renal dysfunction [naproxen:drug_interactions:7]. The FDA label recommends monitoring patients for methotrexate toxicity during concomitant use [naproxen:drug_interactions:7].
